race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; second foal; brother to Group-placed 1m1f 2yo winner Endorsement (RPR 107), also Group-placed over 1m2f at 3 in 2026; dam unraced sister to winners Johannes Vermeer (7f 2yo Group 1; runner-up in Melbourne Cup) and Elizabeth Browning (1m1f Group 2); trip looks on the short side on his breeding but Ballydoyle first-choice on jockey bookings.
comment: Brother to Group-placed 1m1f 2yo winner Endorsement; Moore's pick

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
spotlight: Blue Point colt is closely related to 7f AW 2yo winner Greek Mythology (RPR 99), half-brother to 7f/1m winner Atlantic Coast (inc 2yo Group 3/Australia; 104); dam Group-placed 9.5f winner (95), half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Groundbreaking; yard in top form so newcomer has to be respected.
comment: Blue Point colt related to some decent 2yos; yard in top form so has to be respected

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
spotlight: No Nay Never brother to 5f/6f 2yo winner First Approach (RPR 89), half-brother to winners Lisboa (1m2f; 84) and Sound It Out (Australian 7f-1m); dam Group-placed 6f winner (109), closely related to useful 7f/1m winner Aerion Power; seemingly Ballydoyle second-choice but don't rule out.
comment: Brother to 5f/6f 2yo winner First Approach

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
spotlight: Kodiac colt bought back for 52,000euros as a yearling; dam placed 1m3f/1m4f (RPR 76), half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Besharah; needs checking in the market on debut.
comment: Kodiac colt, out of a Galileo half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Besharah

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
spotlight: Coulsty colt a 10,000euros foal and 35,000euros yearling; brother to 7f 2yo winner Madbadanddangerous (RPR 86), half-brother to winners Marvelosa (10.4f; 84) and Mulsanne (US 1m turf); dam unraced sister to 1m4f Listed winner, closely related to Gold Cup winner Courage Mon Ami; debutant respected from a yard with a decent recent 2yo winner.
comment: Debutant respected from a yard with a decent recent 2yo winner

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
spotlight: St Mark's Basilica half-brother to winners High Definition (1m 2yo inc Group 2, RPR 120), Innisfree (1m Group 3/7f 2yo; 110) and Royal Aide (1m3f/11.7f Flat, 86; 3m/3m1f hurdle); dam 1m and 8.4f (Listed) winner (104); seemingly the Ballydoyle third-choice but worth a look for future reference.
comment: Half-brother to 2yo Group 2 winner High Definition

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
spotlight: Invincible Army gelding; 10,000 yearling; second foal; dam runner-up 6f 2yo (RPR 74), half-sister to winners Insignia Of Rank (1m Listed) and Mayleaf Shine (useful 5f inc 2yo); speedily bred sort but this likely a strong maiden.
comment: Speedily bred sort but this likely a strong maiden

race_name: Tally Ho Stud Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
owner: Walerc Limited/M J Wasylocha/Tony Cantwell/Paul J Nolan
spotlight: Ardad colt cost 45,000GBP as a yearling; third foal; closely related to Spanish 1m winner Running Hot, half-brother to 6f turf 2yo/1m AW winner Priapos (RPR 84); dam 5.7f winner (76), half-sister to winners Global Applause (5f Listed inc 2yo) and Auditor (useful 5f-7f inc 2yo); never recovered from bad start on recent Navan debut; best watched for now.
comment: Never recovered from bad start on recent Navan debut; best watched for now

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Smart, lightly raced 4yo; never quite fulfilled Leopardstown's Derby Trial second this time last year although did end the campaign on a winning note in 1m2f Cork Listed in September in ready fashion; looks the type to make an even better 4yo upped to this trip; very interesting player.
comment: Smart last year and promises to make an even better 4yo upped to this trip; big player

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: German import, having been bought for 875,000euros at Arqana in December; 1-9 for previous yard, winning Group 3 in Hamburg over 1m3f (good) and better form when beaten a neck in Group 2 at Baden-Baden and final start when third in 1m4f Group 1 Gran Premio del Jockey Club in Milan; McMonagle's choice of Joseph O'Brien's quartet so has to be respected.
comment: Ex-German trained filly; Group 1-placed in Italy; choice of Joseph O'Brien's four

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Good form early last season, recording back-to-back wins here in today's event and Group 3 International Stakes over 1m2f; subsequent Leopardstown efforts were below best below best, as was last month's seasonal return here in 1m2f Group 3 Alleged Stakes dominated by two stablemates; entitled to come on for that.
comment: Last year's winner well below best on recent return; entitled to improve for that

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Very useful filly has returned this term with 0.5l defeats by Moody at Listed level at both Cork (1m4f) and Gowran (1m6f), each time forcing it; this a much deeper race than those however so will do well to sneak a place.
comment: Two narrow defeats at this level recently; this looks a much deeper race though

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Lightly raced last year at 3, winning minor Roscommon contest and chased home a very smart type in Leopardstown Listed over this trip; recently landed odds in Cork 4yo maiden hurdle, an unusual prep for one from this yard; cheekpieces fitted for Flat return and bit to find on ratings.
comment: Recent maiden hurdle winner; cheekpieces fitted for Flat return and bit to find on ratings

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Consistent last season, going close in 1m2f Group 3 Gallinule Stakes on this weekend and later in year twice runner-up in Longchamp Group contests over 1m7f; both runs this term at 1m6f, latest when respectable third to Scandinavia in Navan Listed; possible fitness edge on some of these.
comment: Possible fitness edge on some of these but ideally wants further at this stage
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Emit', 'horse_id': 6265717, 'quote': "He finished off last year well and he'll probably go down the staying route. It was a nice run when he was fourth on his comeback and I expect him to step forward nicely from that. We're looking at going to Navan or Chester next. 22-04-26"}]

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Third career win came on final start last season in 1m Listowel Listed in testing conditions under a positive ride (just a day after being well beaten in handicap); balance of form is over shorter than this so others preferred on seasonal return.
comment: Absent since 1m Listed win in September; this trip stretches him

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Ex Ballydoyle-trained; won Lingfield Derby Trial last year but well held in both Irish Derby and Irish St Leger; bought for 78,000gns and soundly beaten on yard debut in Grade 2 Leopardstown hurdle at Christmas; tried in a tongue-tie here and plenty on his plate in what looks a hot Listed race.
comment: Last year's Lingfield Derby Trial winner didn't progress;  tried in tongue-tie
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Puppet Master', 'horse_id': 6166366, 'quote': "He's a good staying colt who showed he was tough and hardy when winning the Lingfield Derby Trial. Ryan liked him that day and the plan was always to come here next. He seems well and seems to stay well. 13-06-25"}]

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: Fairly useful handicapper over shorter trips; big jump in trip here and out of her depth.
comment: Fairly useful handicapper over shorter trips; big jump in trip here and out of her depth

race_name: Sherry FitzGerald Country Homes Orby Stakes (Listed Race)
spotlight: In the form of his life last year, winning 1m4f Roscommon Listed on seasonal debut and better again upped to 2m at this venue, unlucky narrow defeat in Irish Cesarewitch and ready winner of Group 3 Loughbrown Stakes in November on heavy; ideally wants it softer and this looks a tough enough task on seasonal return but has to be respected.
comment: Better than ever last year; runs well fresh but ideally wants it softer

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Now 11lb higher than for C&D win in March, an emphatic success gained at the main expense of the Irish Lincoln winner Ribee; has maintained progress with a wide-margin win in a handicap hurdle at Bellewstown; strong contender.
comment: Now 11lb higher than for C&D win in March, has maintained progress with a win over hurdles

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Joined this yard for E210,000 after showing useful form in France; won a rated race over the extended mile at the Galway festival (soft); fair third of seven in a Listed race at Cork on final start last year; fourth at the same level at Naas on return; talented apprentice booked; may prove the pick of stable's three runners; leading chance.
comment: Has shown enough in Listed races to suggest she could go close, talented apprentice booked

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Consistent last season; ended with C&D second behind today's rival Retracement on handicap debut; jumping let her down in juvenile hurdles; sharpened for return to the Flat by a handicap run at the Punchestown festival.
comment: Consistent last season, ended with C&D second, sharpened by a hurdles run at Punchestown
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'In My Teens', 'horse_id': 7622789, 'quote': "She's run well in four starts on the Flat and will go juvenile hurdling. She's done a good bit of schooling and jumps well. 04-11-25"}]

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Has shown a liking for this track, gained a second 1m success here in March; suited by soft ground; holding his form well on the evidence of Cork third; would benefit from any easing.
comment: Has shown a liking for this track, suited by soft ground, would benefit from any easing

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Two soft ground wins last term; found 1m inadequate here on seasonal debut; much better when second at Cork, with Apercu back in fourth; could be in the mix.
comment: Found 1m inadequate here on seasonal debut. much better at Cork, could be in the mix
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Iron Fist', 'horse_id': 6046682, 'quote': "He ran an absolute cracker when second at Cork on Friday. He seemed to really enjoy stepping up to a mile and a quarter and it looks a really nice trip for him. There should be some good races in him through the summer. He showed on Friday that he doesn't mind that bit of nicer ground, which opens up plenty of options. 27-04-26"}]

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Ex-Dermot Weld, won her first two starts last season, both at Gowran over a slightly shorter trip than this; highly tried later in the season; interesting recruit to this yard.
comment: Ex-Dermot Weld, won her first two starts last season, interesting recruit to this yard

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Won over the extended version of this trip at Dundalk last November on stable debut; should be suited by this return to a longer trip after two seconds over 1m; good claimer aboard.
comment: Should be suited by this return to a longer trip after two seconds over 1m, good claimer

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Winner of three of her six races for Ralph Beckett; clear chance on best form, though issue complicated by the fact that she is one of three runners for a stable in superb form.
comment: Winner of three of her six races for Ralph Beckett, obvious chance with yard in super form
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Perfect Your Craft', 'horse_id': 6509775, 'quote': "She's done well over the winter and will probably go for a trial. The ground will be important as she wants a bit of juice. Her win on her debut at Salisbury came on heavy and she learned plenty that day. She'll stay very well. 28-04-25"}]

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Fifth behind Apercu in this event 12 months ago; C&D winner on penultimate start last season, beating subsequent improver Fiver Friday; final outing over 1m4f was too bad to be true.
comment: C&D winner on penultimate start last season, final outing over 1m4f was too bad to be true

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Five-time winner, beaten a short head by Apercu in this race last season; back from a spell in Bahrain; generally reliable performer at 1m2f/1m4f.
comment: Back from a spell in Bahrain, five-time winner, generally reliable performer at 1m2f/1m4f

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Four turf wins, including this race last year, beating Cloud Seeker by a short head; not far behind Iron Fist on seasonal debut at Cork; out of her comfort zone in a Listed race at Gowran last time; respected now on the same mark as 12 months ago.
comment: Not far behind Iron Fist at Cork, out of her comfort zone in a Listed race last time
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Apercu', 'horse_id': 5396360, 'quote': "She will probably go for the Northfields Handicap. She won nicely at Naas and she stepped up to a mile and half at the Curragh and finished sixth, which I was a bit disappointed with as I thought she had a great chance. I'm not quite sure she got the trip, so we're bringing her back in distance. She'll be near the bottom of the handicap but she has a fair chance of getting in. 11-09-24"}]

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: No wins last season but strong form in defeat in big staying handicaps; fourth in the amateur handicap at Galway, fifth in the Irish Cesarewitch and signed off with a fine second in the Cesarewitch; runs over an inadequate trip here on second start of the season.
comment: Group 2 course winner at 2m, fine second in last year's Cesarewitch, inadequate trip here
stable_tour: [{'horse': 'Dawn Rising', 'horse_id': 2394610, 'quote': 'He needs to find his form again but I think it usually takes him a few runs, so hopefully he might bounce back at Ascot.  13-06-25'}, {'horse': 'Dawn Rising', 'horse_id': 2394610, 'quote': "He had a nice run at Leopardstown in the Saval Beg and wasn't beaten far, so hopefully he'll run a nice race in the Queen Alexandra Stakes. 16-06-23"}]

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Fair form at 7f/1m in Britain; appeared not to stay this trip at Newcastle in January; tough task against that background.
comment: Fair form at 7f/1m in Britain, appeared not to stay this trip at Newcastle in January

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Ended last season with a 1m1f maiden win on heavy ground at Leopardstown; may step up from his 1m run here in March; needs to reverse form with Perry Mason; finished in front of Calm The Jets and Iron Fist.
comment: Ended last season with a 1m1f maiden win, may step up from his 1m run here in March

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Third in the 2024 Dante and generally kept good company on the Flat in Britain; started brightly in Ireland last spring; has become disappointing; plenty to prove at this stage.
comment: Third place in 2024 Dante is becoming a distant memory, plenty to prove at this stage

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Landed a 1m maiden at Dundalk on debut early last year; did not appear last turf season; fair run over 1m here on turf debut; needs to settle better than at Cork a month ago.
comment: 1m AW winner, fair run over 1m here on turf debut, needs to settle better than at Cork

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: No hint so far of the form that brought him eight wins in France, including a Listed race over this trip two seasons ago; has beaten only one opponent in each of his two Irish starts; headgear tried now.
comment: No hint so far of the form that brought him eight wins in France, headgear tried now

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
owner: Albert Dravins & Exors of the Late Eamonn Scanlon
spotlight: A long time since he showed his best form; the most recent of his two wins was in 2023; towards the rear in three outings this season; 6lb out of the handicap, can be ruled out.
comment: Towards the rear in three outings this season, 6lb out of the handicap, can be ruled out

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Sprang 125-1 shock in a 1m2f Navan maiden last September, proved that was no fluke later in the month when going down narrowly on handicap debut over 1m5f at Down Royal; progress not maintained in two subsequent outings; cheekpieces on now.
comment: Struck form last autumn, progress not maintained in two subsequent outings, cheekpieces on

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Five turf wins include a 1m4f course success during a solid 2025 campaign; below his best in two outings this term; mid-field behind today's Perry Mason on the first occasion.
comment: Course 1m4f winner during a solid 2025 campaign, below his best in two outings this term

race_name: Keadeen Hotel Handicap (Premier Handicap)
spotlight: Two wins in France (on soft and AW); has won over 1m7f, and had never raced at under 1m4f until recent Irish debut at Sligo; unplaced favourite after starting slowly and meeting trouble in running; trip is a concern, but unwise to discount.
comment: French import who stays considerably further than this, no luck in running on Irish debut

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Looked smart when landing the Group 2 Mill Reef Stakes at Newbury (6f, heavy) on final juvenile start; beat only one rival in his first two races last term; produced massive shock (200-1) when beating the favourite Lazaat in 6f Group 1 at Ascot last October (good); wind-surgery evidently the key to that success; little mileage on the clock, fascinating prospect for this season.
comment: Won Ascot Group 1 at 200-1, little mileage on the clock, fascinating prospect this term

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Late-maturing type won the Group 1 Sprint Cup at Haydock (good) in 2024; did not appear last year until September and failed to recapture his best form in three runs, only fifth behind Spycatcher when favourite at Doncaster on last of them; reversed that form (and had James's Delight behind) when fourth in a 6f Listed race at the same venue eight weeks ago.
comment: Late-maturing type won the Group 1 Sprint Cup at Haydock in 2024, not at best in 2025

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
spotlight: Group 1-winning juvenile over C&D; returned from aborted stud career last year and won a 5f Listed race at Naas (good) and a C&D Group 3 (6f, good); fine third in the Group 1 Flying Five before failing to run to expectations at the Breeders' Cup; well below best on soft on seasonal debut at Cork; better over 5f at Naas, but needs more to make an impact here.
comment: Group 1-winning juvenile over C&D, Group 1-placed here last season, fair chance if on song

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Useful form at 7m/1m last season, fifth in the Irish 2,000 Guineas, third in the Jersey Stakes, odds-on for 7f Naas win; kept on for third in 7f Group 2 in Saudi Arabia in February; ran as well as could have been expected when fifth of eight behind the spectacular Ka Ying Rising at Sha Tin last month; trip possibly a little sharp for him.
comment: Useful form at 7m/1m last season, hard to be sure he has the speed to match some of these

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Won a 6f Listed at Doncaster early last season (good to soft); ended 2025 in top form with convincing wins in Group 3 at Chantilly (very soft) and a Listed race at Doncaster (Montassib fifth); failed to uphold form with Montassib at the same venue on seasonal debut.
comment: Failed to uphold previous form with Montassib at Doncaster on seasonal debut, likes soft

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)

comment: Won this event on good ground last 12 months ago, this is a deeper race than last year's

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Splendid veteran showed he retained enthusiasm when winning the 7f Gladness Stakes in March, his ninth Curragh win on his 50th visit; found 5f too sharp at Naas last time; runs in this event for the fourth consecutive year, second at 25-1 in 2023, ninth in 2024, third behind James Delight at 33-1 last season; asking a lot now in a strong edition.
comment: Durable course specialist, twice placed in this race, asking a lot now in a strong edition

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: All three wins have come at 1m; back after a spell in the Emirates; not far off best when touched off by Elnajmm in the 7f Group 2 Al Fahidi Fort in January; beaten 3l in fourth behind the same horse in a Group 3 last time; blinkered first time now; not appealing at this trip.
comment: All three wins have come at 1m, back after a spell in the Emirates, trip looks inadequate

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: C&D maiden winner at two; found wanting in two stakes races last year; same over 7f in a Group 3 at Leopardstown on seasonal debut.
comment: Found wanting in two stakes races last year, same over 7f in a Group 3 on seasonal debut

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
spotlight: Sole win on turf in the 2023 Norfolk Stakes; has won five conditions races at Dundalk since, the most recent over 5f in February; has struggled since then, most recently last Sunday at Naas; out of his depth here.
comment: Norfolk Stakes winner in 2023, five AW wins, out of his depth here judged on recent form

race_name: Weatherbys Ireland Greenlands Stakes (Group 2)
spotlight: Non-runner
comment: Non-runner

race_name: Tattersalls Irish 2,000 Guineas (Group 1)
owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
spotlight: Beat stablemate True Love on debut before landing the Coventry Stakes; second in three consecutive Group 1 races, including the National Stakes and the Dewhurst; ended the campaign by overcoming a wide trip in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf at Del Mar (1m, firm); has evidently trained on and can go one better than in the 2,000 Guineas by upholding form with Distant Storm.
comment: Crowned last season with Breeders' Cup win, can uphold Newmarket form with Distant Storm

race_name: Tattersalls Irish 2,000 Guineas (Group 1)
spotlight: E1,900,000 breeze-up purchase last spring; very smart juvenile form, aside from when pulling too hard in the Acomb; impressed in winning a 1m Group 3 event at Newmarket in September before a fine third placing (1 1/2l behind Gstaad) in the Dewhurst; now has an 8l deficit to overturn in another clash with Gstaad following his distant 2,000 Guineas third; first-time cheekpieces.
comment: Not far off Gstaad in the Dewhurst, 8l behind him in the 2,000 Guineas, likely second-best

race_name: Tattersalls Irish 2,000 Guineas (Group 1)
owner: Cayton Park Stud & Mrs John Magnier
spotlight: Chesham Stakes runner-up and Listed winner at Tipperary before a respectable effort in a 1m Canadian Grade 1 on final 2yo start; won going away from Power Blue (gave 3lb) in Group 3 at Leopardstown (7f, good to yielding) on reappearance; pulled very hard in the 2,000 Guineas; fifth was a decent outcome in the circumstances; can make his presence felt if settling better.
comment: Ran with credit the 2,000 Guineas despite pulling too hard, place chance if settling well

race_name: Tattersalls Irish 2,000 Guineas (Group 1)
spotlight: Won Leicester novice event by 5l on debut and landed a valuable sales event over an extended 6f at this venue last September; finished 4l behind runner-up Gstaad when a 50-1 shot in the Dewhurst; reversed the form of that race with fourth-placed Zavateri when landing the Greenham at Newbury (7f, good) on reappearance; missed the 2,000 Guineas.
comment: Reversed Dewhurst form with Zavateri in the Greenham, needs to do likewise with Gstaad
